payload.sql: WITH user_order_stats AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.user_level, COUNT(o.order_id) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.payment_method) AS payment_method_count FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_level), level_aggregates AS (SELECT user_level, COUNT(*) AS total_users, SUM(valid_order_count) AS total_valid_orders, SUM(payment_method_count) AS total_payment_methods, SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS users_with_3plus_orders FROM user_order_stats GROUP BY user_level) SELECT user_level, ROUND(COALESCE(total_valid_orders * 1.0 / total_users, 0), 4) AS avg_valid_order_count, ROUND(COALESCE(total_payment_methods * 1.0 / total_users, 0), 4) AS avg_payment_method_count, ROUND(COALESCE(users_with_3plus_orders * 1.0 / total_users, 0), 4) AS pct_users_with_3plus_orders FROM level_aggregates ORDER BY user_level ASC LIMIT 200

payload.question: 请统计各省份中，客户平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该省份中同时使用过线上（alipay/wechat）和线下（card/cash）支付方式的客户占比，按省份升序排列。其中首次/末次下单和支付方式均只统计有效订单；涉及客户平均值和比例时，范围内零有效订单客户也计入分母。
payload.sql: WITH province_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.province, u.user_id FROM users AS u), valid_orders AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.payment_method, o.order_date FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped')), user_payment_summary AS (SELECT u.province, u.user_id, COUNT(o.user_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, MAX(CASE WHEN o.payment_method IN ('alipay', 'wechat') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_online, MAX(CASE WHEN o.payment_method IN ('card', 'cash') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_offline FROM province_users AS u LEFT JOIN valid_orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.province, u.user_id), province_stats AS (SELECT province, ROUND(AVG(order_count), 4) AS avg_order_count, ROUND(AVG(distinct_payment_count), 4) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_online = 1 AND has_offline = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS online_and_offline_ratio FROM user_payment_summary GROUP BY province) SELECT province, avg_order_count, avg_distinct_payment_count, online_and_offline_ratio FROM province_stats ORDER BY province LIMIT 200

payload.question: 统计每个品牌下各品类中，近30天（以2026-09-12为基准）产生过销售的有效订单所覆盖的商品SKU数（即order_items.product_id去重计数），要求仅包含至少被5个不同用户购买过的品牌-品类组合，结果按覆盖SKU数降序排列，最多返回100行。 主排序值相同时，再按品牌、品类升序。
payload.sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sku_count FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) >= 5 ORDER BY sku_count DESC, p.brand ASC, p.category ASC LIMIT 100

payload.sql: WITH brand_category_stats AS (SELECT brand, category, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(list_price) AS mean_price, STDDEV_SAMP(list_price) AS stddev_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND STDDEV_SAMP(list_price) > 0), brand_category_skew AS (SELECT bcs.brand, bcs.category, ROUND((bcs.n * SUM(POWER(p.list_price - bcs.mean_price, 3))) / ((bcs.n - 1) * (bcs.n - 2) * POWER(bcs.stddev_price, 3)), 4) AS skewness FROM brand_category_stats AS bcs JOIN products AS p ON bcs.brand = p.brand AND bcs.category = p.category AND p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY bcs.brand, bcs.category, bcs.n, bcs.mean_price, bcs.stddev_price) SELECT brand, category, skewness FROM brand_category_skew ORDER BY ABS(skewness), brand, category LIMIT 100

     FROM refunds r

     JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
